exposure: Fetal growth restriction (FGR) induced by chronic hypoxia
outcome: Subtle structural abnormalities in the FGR brain
Diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) modelling (mean, axial, radial diffusivity, fractional anisotropy)
Fixel-based analysis of 3-tissue constrained spherical deconvolution (CSD) (fibre cross-section (FC), fibre density (FD), combined fibre density and cross-section (FDC))
cohort: The study participants were newborn preterm FGR and appropriate-for-gestational-age (AGA) lambs.
finding: Fixel-based analysis of 3-tissue CSD demonstrated that preterm neonatal FGR lamb brains exhibited a decrease in fibre cross-section in periventricular white matter, hippocampus, and cerebellar white matter, which was supported by histological evidence of white matter hypomyelination and disorganisation.
birth_weight: FGR lambs: mean 2.2 kg (SD 0.5); AGA lambs: mean 3.3 kg (SD 0.3)
gest_age: 127 days gestation (~32 weeks human brain development)
